article.headline: Collins and American take down Drexel 66-64
article.description: — Madden Collins led American with 23 points, including the game-winning jump shot with one second remaining, and the Eagles beat Drexel 66-64 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Collins and American take down Drexel 66-64
article.story: PHILADELPHIA -- — Madden Collins led American with 23 points, including the game-winning jump shot with one second remaining, and the Eagles beat Drexel 66-64 on Wednesday. Collins shot 9 of 10 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line for the Eagles (1-2). Eric Michaels scored nine points and added six rebounds. Julen Iturbe shot 3 for 7, including 2 for 6 from beyond the arc to finish with eight points, while adding six rebounds. Latief Lorenzano-White led the way for the Dragons (1-2) with 18 points. Drexel also got 13 points and four assists from Panagiotis Pagonis. David Simonovic also had 10 points and three steals. Collins scored eight second-half points for American to help set up the game-winning shot. Up next American takes on Harvard at home on Sunday, and Drexel visits Maine on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
